≈ 2 min to finish

Every Sunday at 8 PM I go live on the House of Aspirants Telegram channel. There is no fixed topic - it is an open doubt session where you can talk to me directly.

What you can ask

  • Any exam doubt - Punjab Police, PSSSB (Clerk, Jail Warder, Patwari, Excise Inspector, Veterinary Inspector and others) or PPSC.
  • Preparation strategy - how to plan your day, which books, how to revise, how to handle negative marking.
  • My Rank 2 strategy - how I scored 713/800 in the Punjab Police Sub Inspector exam and what I would do differently.
  • Anything on House of Aspirants - how to use the quizzes, previous papers, study material and current affairs.

This week

  • PSSSB Clerk candidates: the written exam is reported for 11 October - bring your last-week doubts.
  • Jail Warder and Matron: the result is out and PMT/PET comes next - ask about the physical test.

How to join

  1. Join the House of Aspirants Telegram channel.
  2. Send your doubt in the channel comments before Sunday evening, so I can answer it first.
  3. On Sunday at 8 PM, open the channel and tap the live stream.

The live is free and open to everyone. After the session, the main questions and answers will be added to this page.
